summary: GATE-EX5 closes as pass_with_conditions for design-contract review only. It accepts the EX-5 operation/answer-skill/q19 extraction contract as adequate for later bounded validator/CLI planning, while preserving all candidate-write, q19 extraction execution, protected mutation, lesson-output, CP-6/Year-1 closure, and student/product-use blocks.

explicit_decisions.decision: Close GATE-EX5 as pass_with_conditions - design-contract review only.
Keep future operation candidates, answer-skill candidates, and source-annex extraction overlays under governed references/data/exam-ingestion overlay paths before any machine promotion.
Accept the operation-candidate fields as sufficient for later validator/CLI planning; dry-run EX_OP_ANNUAL_COST_THRESHOLD_COMPARISON before real candidate writes.
Accept the answer-skill fields as sufficient to keep q3 threshold wording and q15 two-step correction-model explanation visible as answer-construction needs.
Accept q19 graph/source extraction fields as sufficient preconditions; source_page_or_locator must be precise for q19.

Accept validator/CLI preconditions for later planning; validators must reject unauthorized mutation flags, hidden gaps, invalid A15/A45 support, product-use flags, and student-facing output authorization.
Preserve q3 A61 support with A15 rejected, q19 A42/D10 support with A45 weak, q19 gaps blocking, and q3/q15 answer-skill needs visible.
Authorize EX-6 Validator And CLI Implementation Planning only, with no candidate writes and no q19 extraction execution.

No protected reference mutation, external-source mutation, machine-reference mutation, unit minting, operation-registry mutation, answer-skill mutation, q19 extraction execution, PV/graph mutation, lesson-output mutation, CP-6 closure, Year-1 closure, diagnostics, adaptive routing, mastery, sequencing, student-facing AI, summative use, PV projection, PV machine promotion, or student-facing output is authorized.

accepted_outcomes: GATE-EX5 may close as a design-contract review gate.
Future operation candidates, answer-skill candidates, and source-annex extraction overlays remain overlay-first under references/data/exam-ingestion/.
Operation-candidate fields are sufficient for later validator/CLI planning.
Answer-skill fields are sufficient to keep q3 and q15 correction-model answer needs visible.
q19 extraction fields are sufficient as a precondition for any later extraction execution.
Validator/CLI preconditions are sufficient for a later implementation-planning sprint.
GATE-EX4 routing facts are preserved: q3 A61 support with A15 rejected; q19 A42/D10 support with A45 weak; q19 gaps blocking; q3/q15 answer-skill needs visible.
A bounded EX-6 validator/CLI implementation planning sprint may follow, with no candidate writes and no q19 extraction execution.
blocked_outcomes: No protected reference mutation is authorized.
No q19 source-annex extraction execution is authorized.
No q19 graph-object extraction execution is authorized.
No student diagnostics, adaptive routing, mastery decisions, automatic sequencing, student-facing AI, summative use, PV projection, PV machine promotion, or student-facing output is authorized.
conditions_to_reopen_or_pass: q19 remains blocked while q19-source-annex-gap and q19-graph-object-gap are unresolved.
The next sprint should test schemas and validators against dry-run fixtures before any persistent candidate-storage path exists.
Validators must reject A15 as q3 annual-threshold support and A45 as the primary q19 graph-shift support.
q3 threshold wording and q15 two-step correction-model explanation must remain visible downstream as answer-skill needs.
allowed_next_sprint_scope: design mutation log and rollback format
create dry-run fixtures only if explicitly non-persistent and test-only
